description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PDPI-03
**Title:** ऑफर प्राप्त करें lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Eka 3W Cargo Price in Mumbai
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Open Eka 3W Cargo Price in Mumbai, click “ऑफर प्राप्त करें”, fill a valid name, an invalid 5-digit mobile number, leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The mobile-format and location-required validation messages are shown, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open Eka 3W Cargo Price in Mumbai
2. Click ऑफर प्राप्त करें
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city empty
5. Verify mobile-format and location messages
